title: Osgir — Captain of the Dawnsire
summary: Osgir doubles cheap artifacts and damage reflectors, then feeds them with wipes, Arcbond, and a stationed Dawnsire.

tags.name: artifacts
tags.reason: Osgir, welders, Oswald, artifact lands, and almost every payoff want artifacts in play or in the graveyard.

tags.name: aikido
tags.reason: A full reflector suite turns incoming damage, fights, and red sweepers into player-facing damage.

tags.name: self-damage
tags.reason: Blasphemous Act, Chain Reaction, Spiteful Banditry, and Arcbond are aimed at our own reflectors on purpose.

tags.name: spacecraft
tags.reason: The brew is named for Dawnsire; Warmaker Gunship and Adagia share the station axis.

tags.name: artificers
tags.reason: Osgir, Oswald, Goblin Engineer, Goblin Welder, and Losheel are the reconstruction crew.

tags.name: burn
tags.reason: Reflectors, Bottle-Cap Blast, Pyrite Spellbomb, and red sweepers close through damage.

tags.name: clones
tags.reason: Osgir makes two copies, plus Sculpting Steel, Cursed Mirror, Mycosynth Gardens, and Adagia.

tags.name: combo
tags.reason: Arcbond plus a reflector plus a wipe is a finite but lethal table-wide line, not a loop.

tags.name: graveyard
tags.reason: Osgir, Welder, Engineer, Tune Up, Abuelo's Awakening, and Buried Ruin all spend the yard.

tags.name: sacrifice
tags.reason: Osgir's pump, Oswald, Engineer, Welder, and wellsprings all want artifacts to die.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Osgir's copies, Treasures, Prized Statue, Atsushi, and Titanic are the board.

tags.name: dragons
tags.reason: Wrathful Red Dragon pays off Atsushi and Cavern-Hoard Dragon when they are damaged.

tags.name: equipment
tags.reason: Basilisk Collar, Shadowspear, and Celestial Armor sit on reflectors; Forging the Tyrite Sword finds them.

tags.name: lifegain
tags.reason: Collar, Shadowspear, Kami, Wall of Hope, and Metropolis Reformer convert reflector hits into life.

tags.name: vehicles
tags.reason: RMS Titanic is a real Vehicle; Dawnsire and Warmaker are spacecraft that station into creatures.

tags.name: politics
tags.reason: Seize the Spotlight is the only fame-or-fortune bargain.
